name: Navjot
text:
the parcel locker wouldnt open at the station n my code was rejected twice, can you reset it b4 tmora, thanks,
Navjot

name: Canossi
text:
the smart meter display went blank after the power cut n the readings havent shown since, the app still works n shows usage so its just the unit, can someone swap it or send a new one, thanks,
Canossi

name: Chlodwig Cosmin-Adrian
text:
my season ticket renewal was charged twice n the second payment is still pending on my statement, my card ends 4412, i called the helpline n was told to wait five days but its been two weeks, can you refund the extra n confirm on email, thanks,
Chlodwig Cosmin-Adrian

name: Nitcha Jerónima
text:
the click and collect slot i booked for sat vanished from the app n the store says they have no record, pls help, thanks,
Nitcha Jerónima

name: Biagina
text:
the bus pass i ordered online never arrived n the tracking says delivered, i was home all day n the cameras show nothing, can you send a replacement or refund, thanks,
Biagina

name: Garcia
text:
the garage door sensor keeps beeping every few minutes n the app logs say tamper alert, i changed the battery n wiped the contacts but it came back tonite, the neighbours can hear it thru the wall, pls book an engineer, happy to pay the call out, thanks,
Garcia

name: Marki Bourhis
text:
the key fob for the car park stopped working n the barrier stayed down, i had to reverse out, pls reprogram it, thanks,
Marki Bourhis

name: Jannik Rospondek
text:
the wifi drops every evening around eight n comes back after a few minutes, the router shows no error n the line test is clean, it happens on every device so its not my laptop, can you check from your end, thanks,
Jannik Rospondek

name: Cabdulahi
text:
the refund for the cancelled course was promised in five days n its been three weeks, i have the chat log n the case ref, the card hasnt changed so it should go straight back, can you chase the payments team n tell me when it lands, thanks,
Cabdulahi

name: Neitzert
text:
the gate remote for the flat block died n the spare went missing, i cant get in without buzzing the neighbour, pls sort it, thanks,
Neitzert

name: Nimet Shilo
text:
my booking for the skip was moved without asking n the new date clashes with the neighbours move, i rang n waited 20 mins n got cut off, can you put it back to sat or refund, thanks,
Nimet Shilo

name: Al Ahdali
text:
the loft insulation job was left half done n the crew said someone would book the finish n nobody has, the hatch is off n the pipes are boxed but the far side is bare, its been like that a month n my calls go to voicemail, pls get someone out, thanks,
Al Ahdali

name: Sintayehu
text:
Hi both, the minibus is booked for the away fixture on the 15th and the driver has the route. Could you confirm the pick up times by friday. Thanks,
Sintayehu

name: Hendricks
text:
Hi team, the training room switch is confirmed for tuesday morning and the projector is booked with it. The door code changes at nine so collect the new fobs from reception. Let me know if the room clashes with the interview panel. Thanks,
Hendricks

name: Senanur Nivethitha
text:
Hi all, the end of term concert moves to the main hall because the stage lights in the small hall failed the test. The rehearsal on thursday stands and the piano is being tuned that morning. Tickets are on sale at the office and the choir list is pinned by the door. Thanks,
Senanur Nivethitha

name: Sopiko Khurana Kehrwand
text:
Hello, the community garden survey is due on the 20th and the forms are in the shed. Could the plot leads send their counts by friday. Thanks,
Sopiko Khurana Kehrwand

name: Kornél
text:
Hi folks, the waste collection day moves to wednesday from next week while the bridge repairs are on. Bins should be out by seven and the glass box goes with the paper. The old timetable is being reprinted. Thanks,
Kornél

name: Esfandiari
text:
Hi everyone, the maintenance window for the server room is set for saturday from six and should finish by ten. Shared drives will be read only for part of the morning and the print queue will pause. Please save your work locally on friday. The status page will carry updates and the helpdesk is open as usual. Thanks,
Esfandiari

name: Doncho Veselý
text:
Hi, the recipe books from the fair are ready to pick up and are boxed by the office. Two copies per stall if possible. Thanks,
Doncho Veselý

name: Flego Vanicek
text:
Hello all, the library stock check starts monday and the scanners are at the front desk. Please leave the returns on the trolley so the counts are accurate. The quiet room stays open through the week. Thanks,
Flego Vanicek

name: Crisanta
text:
Hi team, the disaster recovery test ran overnight and the failover worked, though two jobs overran their window. The report will land on monday with the timings and the follow up actions. Please review the draft before the review meeting on wednesday. Backup tapes are already off site. Thanks,
Crisanta

name: Sikila
text:
Hi, the village hall hire form is online now and the new rates start in april. Bookings open monday. Thanks,
Sikila

name: Neykova Kardouch Halfmouw
text:
Hello, the spring bulb order closes friday and the catalogue is in the cabin. Orders go in as a group so add your name to the sheet with the quantity and variety. Payment is on collection in october. Thanks,
Neykova Kardouch Halfmouw

name: Wimonwan Wantana
text:
Hi everyone, the community fridge trial starts on the 4th and the rota for checks is almost full. Volunteers log temperatures twice daily and note anything past its date. The fridge sits by the pantry door and the cleaning kit is underneath. Training is a short walkthrough on the 2nd. Thanks,
Wimonwan Wantana

name: Radica
text: Radica here, my water bill jumped to double last quarter n nothing changed at home, the meter reading on the bill doesnt match mine, can someone look at it.

name: Thompson
text: Thompson here, the recycling bin wasnt emptied again n the crew said the lorry had a fault, i rang the depot n the line says the round moves to sat but the neighbours got a different story, can you confirm what is happening.

name: Mamounata Aurelle Király
text: Mamounata Aurelle Király here, my standing order for the gym went up without any notice n the email i got says the change came in june, i checked my old contract n it says fixed for the year, the desk told me to email you so here we are, can someone check n put it back.

name: Maryléne Akjime
text: Maryléne Akjime here, my shed permit has been stuck at received six weeks n the gate code still doesnt work, pls untangle it.

name: Ivica
text: Ivica here, the replacement tap for the kitchen came in the wrong finish n the returns label wasnt in the box, the chat agent said a new label would be emailed, nothing has arrived n the tap is still boxed, can you send it again.

name: Pollán
text: Pollán here, the day pass i bought for the pool isnt showing on my account n the turnstile wouldnt let me in, the desk checked my email n said the barcode was void, i have the receipt n the bank shows the payment n the app shows nothing, i missed my swim n want it sorted.

name: Cigdem Maridati Goudron
text: Cigdem Maridati Goudron here, my library card works at the main desk but not the self service machines, the code on the back is worn, can you reprint the card.

name: Maiane Bresson
text: Maiane Bresson here, the meeting room i booked came with no screen n the cable was missing from the drawer, the front desk said rooms without screens are labelled but mine wasnt n the sheet said projector, can you swap my next booking.

name: Lizzy
text: Lizzy here, the swimming pool changing rooms were closed again n there was no sign until the desk, we had to get changed in the corridor by the cafe n the tiles were wet, other parents said the same happened last week, the duty manager wasnt around, can someone at least put a notice up.

name: Khanfir
text: Khanfir here, the app logs me out every time i try to pay n the basket empties, i reinstalled it twice already, can you pass this to the devs.

name: Brulc Thillai
text: Brulc Thillai here, the coach i booked for the hen do arrived an hour late n the driver took the wrong slip road, we lost half the tour n the organiser says the depot blamed traffic, can we have a partial refund.

name: Ninoslava Laval Morvay
text: Ninoslava Laval Morvay here, the new mattress was delivered with a tear along the seam n the drivers wouldnt take it back, they said the returns team handles it n support says the drivers should have, i have photos n the delivery note, its been sat in the hall a week now.

name: Dobrivoe
text: Dobrivoe here, the cat flap i fitted from your kit lets in a draught n the screws stripped the frame, the shop says ask you direct, can you advise.

name: Ihyane
text: Ihyane here. The keys for the church hall will be with the warden from thursday and the alarm code stays the same. Please make sure the side door is locked when you leave. The new chairs arrive friday.

name: Rospondek
text: Rospondek here. The groundwater reports are drafted and the two flagged wells are on the map with the sample dates. The lab is rerunning the nitrate tests and the results should land by friday. The client pack goes out monday once the signatures are in. The county file reference has been updated.

name: Natayeiso Finianos Allalouf
text: Natayeiso Finianos Allalouf here. The boiler for the flat is booked in for tuesday and the plumber has the keypad code. Please leave the cupboard clear.

name: Song Vuaridel
text: Song Vuaridel here. The room hire invoice went out today and the deposit shows as cleared. The caretaker will set the tables friday evening. Let me know if the stage extension is needed.

name: Alex
text: Alex here. The river clean up went ahead with twelve volunteers and the bank between the bridge and the mill is clear. The tyre pile needs a lorry and the council has been asked to collect. Keep the gloves in the shed for the next one.

name: Giacomucci
text: Giacomucci here. The order cut off for next week moves to wednesday noon and the van leaves at two. Late orders roll to the following run.

name: Rüd Painceira
text: Rüd Painceira here. The harvest supper tickets are nearly gone and the kitchen needs two more helpers for the serving. Payment can go to the usual account. The desserts list is on the board.

name: Yalangoz Machann
text: Yalangoz Machann here. The winter timetable for the ferries starts on the 30th and the evening crossing moves forward by twenty minutes. The booking system reflects the change from tomorrow. Foot passengers keep the same gate. The car deck loads from lane three. Check the board before boarding.

name: Israël
text: Israël here. The security review moved to the 11th and the walk round starts at ten. Sign in at the main gate as usual.

name: Spoletini
text: Spoletini here. The stage crew call for the panto is saturday at nine and the get in should finish by lunch. Bring steel toe boots and a torch. The lighting desk is already in place.

name: Matsang Souvlakis
text: Matsang Souvlakis here. The archive move is done for the northern rooms and the shelving arrives next week for the rest. Boxes are labelled by year and the index is on the shared drive. Anything with a red tag needs a decision from the owner before it moves. The reading room stays open as normal.

name: van Ligten
text: van Ligten here. The drain outside the workshop was rodded and the grate was reset. The yard is clear for the delivery.

name: Mampasi
text: Mampasi here. The register for the summer play scheme closes on the 8th and the first payment is due then. Places are limited to thirty and the waiting list opens after. The gazebo and the craft boxes are stored in the unit.
